headline: Second reading of a policy prohibiting smart glasses and wearable recording devices, plus rescinding four nutrition and health policies.
summary: The superintendent will report on screen time and artificial intelligence and give an update from the Massachusetts School Building Authority (MSBA). A consent agenda covers a Harvard Model United Nations field trip and two FY27 warrants.
